settings.heading: Have a piece to sell?
settings.body: We buy statues outright — no commission, and we don't sell on your behalf. Tell us what you have and we'll come back with an offer.

settings.title: Your statue, brought to your door.
settings.text: See the delivery price for your postcode before you buy, or collect free in London. Add in-home assembly and original box storage where available.

settings.title: Your bonus · a free buy-back quote.
settings.text: Ready to make room for your next piece? Bring this one back to us for a free buy-back quote. We'll assess it and tell you what we can offer. It's your call whether to sell.

settings.title: The Hassle-Free Handover Guarantee.
settings.text: The exact statue shown. The condition described. Every part listed. If it arrives damaged, a listed part is missing, or it differs from the listing, return it for a full refund. We'll arrange and pay for collection.

settings.title: Choose your piece
settings.text: Order online. Ask us anything first — we'll send extra photographs of any detail.

settings.title: Check your postcode
settings.text: Enter it on the statue's page and you'll see your personal delivery price straight away, before you buy.

settings.title: Collect free, or we drive it to you
settings.text: Collect from us in London at no charge, usually ready within 24 hours. Or one of us brings it to your door and carries it in.

settings.title: Add setting up, or box storage
settings.text: Have us unbox and assemble it where you want it. Let us keep the original box — first month free, then £19.99 a month.

settings.heading: How it reaches you
settings.body: A statue is not a parcel. Here is exactly what happens between your order and the piece standing in your home.

settings.heading: The Hassle-Free Handover Guarantee
settings.body:
You'll receive the exact statue shown in the listing, in the condition described and with all the parts listed. If it arrives damaged, a listed part is missing, or the statue differs from its description, you can return it for a full refund — and we'll arrange and pay for collection.

Your statutory rights are unaffected.
